disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking or bidding construction work without possessing a required license or without possessing the proper classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking, attempting to, or submitting a price or bid; offering to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, or in any manner assume charge of the construction...without possessing a license for which a license is required or without possessing a license with the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or distributing a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing, transmitting, distributing, or otherwise publicly circulating a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification in any medium, including but not limited to digital platforms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor that caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor which has caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license, or providing false information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license; misrepresentation of fact by an applicant or licensee in providing information, statements, or documents to the staff or board; deception by omission; and providing false testimony to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of this Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of this Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor for work requiring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work or activity for the performance of which a license is required by this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or fraudulent use of a license by someone other than the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license to be used for any purpose by any person other than the person to whom the license is issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide written notification to the board of any change to application information within thirty calendar days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide written notification to the board of any change to the information provided in the original application and any amendments thereto within thirty calendar days.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting a person to circumvent the provisions of this Chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting a person to circumvent the provisions of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project, or deviating from plans without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project engaged in or undertaken by any licensee or deviating from or disregarding plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner and the design professional.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain a permit to perform work or beginning work prior to permit issuance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain a permit to perform work or beginning work prior to the issuance of a permit in the jurisdiction as required or misrepresenting the value or scope of work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain and provide to the board requested records and documents within five business days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain and provide to the board requested records, documents, and other information as required within five business days of receipt of request.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical contractor" means any person who undertakes to, attempts to, or submits a price or bid or offers to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, perform, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down, or furnishing labor together with material and equipment, or installing the same for the wiring, fixtures, or appliances for the supply of electricity to any residential, commercial, or other project, for which the project value is ten thousand dollars or more.
definition_quote.quote: "Electrical contractor" means any person who undertakes to, attempts to, or submits a price or bid or offers to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, perform, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down, or furnishing labor together with material and equipment, or installing the same for the wiring, fixtures, or appliances for the supply of electricity to any residential, commercial, or other project, for which the project value is ten thousand dollars or more.

methods_authorized.quote: construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down, or furnishing labor together with material and equipment, or installing the same for the wiring, fixtures, or appliances for the supply of electricity

qualifier_required.quote: An applicant for licensure shall designate a qualifying party for each classification and for the Louisiana business and law requirement.

solar_panel_electrical_work_exemption.quote: An Electrical license is required to connect wiring or hookups for any photovoltaic panel or system for which the project value is ten thousand dollars or more.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: Residential construction and its subclassifications, mold remediation, and home improvement applicants shall be required to submit certificates evidencing workers' compensation coverage in compliance with Title 23 of the Louisiana Revised Statutes of 1950

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: Residential construction and its subclassifications, mold remediation, and home improvement applicants shall be required to submit certificates evidencing workers' compensation coverage in compliance with Title 23 of the Louisiana Revised Statutes of 1950, and liability insurance in a minimum amount of one hundred thousand dollars
